purpose: D4 cross-category durability test: 12 hobbies spanning categories not tested (or barely tested) by the D1-D4 calibration rounds, generated through the now-production D4 global style baseline (global_style_v1.json) plus the new global brand-safety policy and the learning.philosophy recipe fix. Uses the REAL production compiler, not an experiment-only style override, since D4 has now been promoted to global_style_v1.json's prompt field.
prior_rounds: catalog/style_calibration_d_18_v1.json (D1/D2/D3, D3 strongest but not special-illustration)
catalog/style_calibration_d4_6_v1.json (D4, decisive improvement, promoted to production this checkpoint)

id_selection_rationale.sports.skateboarding: Required type: sport. Untested in D1-D4. solo_action archetype, single-person action, outdoor, equipment-heavy (board/wheels), tests brand-safety policy against another sport with real-world gear branding risk beyond the already-fixed streetwear sneakers.
id_selection_rationale.outdoors.kayaking: Required type: outdoor activity. Untested. water_outdoors archetype, outdoor environment, equipment-heavy (kayak/paddle/gear).
id_selection_rationale.pets.birds: Required type: pet/animal. Tests companion_bond archetype generalizing beyond pets.dogs (the only companion_bond ID tested in D1-D3) to a structurally different animal.
id_selection_rationale.travel.destination_deep.japanese_onsen_t: Required type: travel. travel_vista archetype. Deliberately chosen for thematic overlap with the historically safety-sensitive sauna/onsen content from earlier FLUX-era rounds, as an extra check that D4's more heightened/dynamic composition style does not reopen that risk even though this is a travel-category ID, not wellness_experience.
id_selection_rationale.music.piano: Required type: music. performance archetype, single-person, indoor, object-focused hero prop (the piano itself), untested (music.guitar was mentioned but not generated in prior rounds either).
id_selection_rationale.wellness.cold_plunge: Required type: wellness. wellness_experience archetype - the third ID in this specific archetype (alongside sauna/hot_springs) and has never been generated anywhere in this remediation arc. Deliberate safety stress test: confirms the existing wellness_experience safety rule still holds under D4's more heightened, dynamic special-illustration composition instructions.
id_selection_rationale.science.marine_biology: Required type: science/learning. learning_exploration archetype - same archetype as learning.philosophy, chosen specifically to confirm the new philosophy-only hobby override did not need to be (and was not accidentally) applied globally, and that sibling learning_exploration hobbies remain fine on their own generic anchor.
id_selection_rationale.technology.3d_printing: Required type: technology. tech_workspace archetype (NOT technology.robotics, which remains quarantined and untouched) - deliberately included as a stress test of whether the new global brand-safety policy plus D4 style hold up on this historically screen/code-leak-prone archetype family, equipment-heavy and screen-adjacent by nature.
id_selection_rationale.crafts.knitting: Required type: craft/making. creative_studio archetype, single-person, indoor, material/object-focused (yarn, needles), untested.
id_selection_rationale.books.reading: Required type: solo hobby. reading_world archetype, calm indoor solo activity, untested in D-rounds, a low-risk control point.
id_selection_rationale.lifestyle.game_nights: Required type: social hobby. group_play archetype, genuine multi-person group scene distinct from gaming.board (one of the 6 D4 calibration cards, not reused here). Already has an existing hobby_overrides_v1.json entry (text-suppression) - a second good test of override-stacking with the new global brand-safety policy, similar to fashion.streetwear.
id_selection_rationale.lifestyle.home_decor: Required type: lifestyle/everyday activity. home_lifestyle archetype, indoor, object-focused (decor items), untested.

avoided: the exact 6 D4 calibration cards (business.coworking, entertainment.movie_subgenre.legal_thriller, fashion.streetwear, food.dish.bun_cha, gaming.board, learning.philosophy) - none reused, no control card was judged necessary given the extensive existing D4 evidence on those 6

expected.note: Input text token charges are additional but small relative to image output cost. Uses the real production compiler (global_style_v1.json = D4, hobby_overrides_v1.json includes the new learning.philosophy fix) - not an isolated experiment style override.

decision_gate.if_gate_met: Recommend D4 (now production global_style_v1.json) as the leading production-style baseline. Do not start bulk generation automatically.
decision_gate.if_localized_issues: Fix at recipe level (hobby_overrides_v1.json), not by rewriting D4 globally.
decision_gate.if_systemic_collapse: Do not keep micro-tuning text indefinitely. Recommend a reference-conditioned gemini-3.1-flash-image style-consistency test instead.
